title: Follow crawfish from field to boil
description: At Crawfish Haven in Louisiana, a crawfish excursion connects the meal to the ponds and work that produce it. Learn how crawfish are harvested, then help with a boil or have the hosts prepare one for you. Sit down to eat while the spices and conversation are still fresh; this is a meal with a story attached.
teaser: Learn the work behind a Louisiana crawfish boil.
goodToKnow: Winter crawfish supply varies with the weather. Confirm the current season, private format and availability well ahead.
whyItMightDelightYou: The best part is how the farm visit turns a delicious meal into a shared local ritual.
